fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: macOS GetComponentDestructor<ls::ClusterPhysicsContentComponent> is exactly ls::HashMap<ls::ID<EntityHandleTraits>, ls::ClusterPhysicsLoadDesc>::~HashMap - the component IS that map. Windows: adder bg3.exe+0x3E83870 allocates 0x40 and zeroes the HashMap members; destructor (thunk bg3.exe+0x3B71AA0 -> bg3.exe+0x3B7CFB0) walks the values (stride 0x38, count = key count +0x2C) releasing the FixedString at +0x30, frees the value array +0x30, the key array +0x20 (plain free, trivial keys: bg3.exe+0x2CEA520), NextIds +0x10 and buckets +0.

summary: Client physics streaming: per-cluster map from content entity to its loaded physics data, kept by ls::ClusterPhysicsLoaderSystem (ApplyLoadResultToEntity, ProcessEntitiesToUnload, Update - Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0x11D680/+0x123D70/+0x128710). On every cluster entity of idle levels (born with the level).
open_questions: Meaning of the bool at +0x34 of the load description (SE calls the source member field_4).

fields.name: Entity

fields.name: Transform
fields.evidence: ViewToLoadDesc copies five qwords (40 bytes) of the view's ls::TransformComponent (SE: Transform, 40 bytes) to +8..+0x30.

fields.name: PhysicsTemplate
fields.evidence: ViewToLoadDesc copy-constructs the FixedString at +0x30 from ls::PhysicsResourceLoadDesciptionComponent +0 (SE Physics.h: PhysicsTemplate). Windows component destructor bg3.exe+0x3B7CFB0 DecRefs the FixedString at +0x30 of every 0x38-byte value.

fields.name: field_34
fields.evidence: ViewToLoadDesc copies PhysicsResourceLoadDesciptionComponent +4 (SE: bool field_4) here.

second_pass: The macOS component destructor names the type (HashMap<EntityHandle, ls::ClusterPhysicsLoadDesc>), the Toolkit ViewToLoadDesc gives the 0x38-byte value (entity, Transform, physics template, flag) and the Windows destructor bg3.exe+0x3B7CFB0 confirms the stride and the FixedString at +0x30; the raw value parts of the first version are replaced by the typed map.
